categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as an ODM supplier specializing in 3C (computer, communication, and consumer electronics) peripheral products and components. Its main product lines include signal conversion and expansion devices, power adapters, precision molds and structural parts, and other electronic accessories. Additionally, the company is developing in the drone and satellite communication sectors. It serves global markets with a focus on mid-to-high-end products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated product development (IPD) systems and maintains advanced R&D facilities including safety certification labs, high-frequency signal testing labs, and industrial 3D printing labs. It focuses on technologies such as USB Type-C full-function interfaces, multi-protocol AI smart fast charging, high-speed data transmission docks, and low-loss long-distance video transmission. Production combines in-house manufacturing with outsourced processing, supported by automated and semi-automated production lines and strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mid-to-high-end 3C electronics brand manufacturers and system integrators, primarily in Europe, North America, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. The company serves industries including consumer electronics, smart home devices, business office equipment, education, gaming, and emerging sectors like satellite communication and drones. Its products are widely used in smartphones, laptops, tablets, digital TVs, VR/AR devices, and other smart terminals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and R&D centers in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Vietnam, with subsidiaries in Singapore and Vietnam. Its sales markets cover over 50 countries and regions globally, with major export destinations including Europe, North America, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. Domestic sales account for approximately 55.56% of revenue, while overseas sales represent about 44.44%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain as an ODM manufacturer, focusing on product design, development, and manufacturing of 3C peripheral components. It integrates upstream mold and precision structural parts production and downstream assembly and testing, forming a closed-loop supply chain. It collaborates closely with upstream chip suppliers and downstream brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in USB Type-C ecosystem products, fast charging technologies, and multi-protocol AI-enabled smart charging systems. It plans to deepen product breadth and depth by expanding into AI, VR/AR applications, and satellite communication chip markets. R&D investments focus on enhancing product compatibility, integration, and industrial design, while also developing new form factors and improving manufacturing automation and efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of ODM products to brand manufacturers and trading customers. The company’s income derives from product sales of signal conversion and expansion devices, power adapters, molds and precision parts, and other electronic accessories. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on volume sales and customized product development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading mid-to-high-end ODM supplier in the 3C peripheral market, recognized for its technical strength, product quality, and customer service. It competes with other domestic and international ODM manufacturers serving global 3C brands. Its certifications (Intel Thunderbolt, VESA, USB-IF, HDMI, HDCP, FCC, CE) and strategic partnerships with chip suppliers provide competitive advantages. The company aims to strengthen its market share by expanding product lines and entering emerging sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 872.5 million, a 27.95% increase over 2023, driven mainly by growth in power adapter products. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 61.06% to about RMB 8.06 million due to increased R&D and sales expenses, lower gross margins from product mix changes, and ramp-up costs at new production sites. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.36 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of approximately RMB 843.6 million, with a modest return on equity of 0.95%. It continues to invest heavily in R&D (7.6% of revenue) and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, compatibility, and superior thermal management in its products, targeting mid-to-high-end market segments. Its integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, including in-house mold and precision part production, enable rapid customization and flexible manufacturing. The company’s strong R&D, early access to new chip technologies, and multiple industry certifications differentiate its offerings. It aims to provide comprehensive smart accessory solutions for business, education, and entertainment scenarios, enhancing user experience and meeting evolving market demands.
